_note: 25 Hz policy = 2 physics steps of 20 ms per action; joint_states publish at 30 Hz sim-time, so every action sees at least one fresh state. Goals stay inside the +-1 rad action range and well inside the +-1.7 rad joint limits. First run (20k steps, log_std_init 0) reached final |err| 0.18 rad and was still improving; 40k steps with log_std_init -1.5 is the second setting.
